whyNothingSawIt.ui: tests/golden/ui/*.json hold HUD and inspector text plus the canonical checksum. Neither moves when a line on the map moves.
whyNothingSawIt.screenshots: the stage captures the same frame twice with the same binary and compares the two PNGs with each other (Assert-FilesEqual $baselineScreenshot $baselineRepeatScreenshot). Two identical mutants agree with each other exactly as well as two identical originals do; there is no committed reference image in the tree (git ls-files tests/golden returns three .json files and nothing else).
whyNothingSawIt.godot: viewInvariantChecksum is the canonical PrototypeWorld checksum asserted equal across four camera/frame/UI-scale cases. It is blind to the camera and to geometry by construction — that is the property the check exists to prove.
whyNothingSawIt.tests: the Presentation suite reads the adapter as text and pins which primitive each routine calls; the number handed to that primitive, and the number handed to the pure geometry function feeding it, are outside what it reads. Issue #295 says exactly this: 'source-guard'ы фиксируют факт вызова процедуры отрисовки, а не её числовые аргументы'.
